scope: Nonmodal supporting evidence in the public map app. No new AGOL items, permissions, source edits, data exports, persistence or hazard rules.

presentation.wide: Calcite Shell Panel in dock mode at the right; one active evidence panel. Map remains interactive.
presentation.phone: Evidence below the map in the existing main workspace, without a modal backdrop or focus trap. Resize reparents the existing DOM.
presentation.briefings: Page controls stay visible above the image. Date / archive or current-public qualification and verification health remain visible; full source metadata is expandable. Original page and PDF links retained.
presentation.mapFeatures: MapView / SceneView native popups disabled; existing record callbacks retain priority, other publisher templates render through arcgis-feature from the same SDK 5.1 CDN loader.
presentation.cameras: Images / video pause while evidence is open; explicit camera selection replaces evidence. Existing camera choice can restore on close; no automatic video playback.

cleanup: One active evidence item; superseded opening requests cannot reopen withdrawn items.
Closing or replacing a briefing aborts pending PDF checks and revokes the Blob URL.
County-site inspector cleanup uses pane-close events; existing sign-out code still clears private source records and closes their panels.
Closing generic map evidence clears graphic, map and view references and destroys its feature component; delayed loads are invalidated.
Removed alerts close their evidence; selecting or closing evidence does not acknowledge or clear hazard notifications.

newCases: Docked markup without application data dialogs
Live refresh does not steal focus

browserLocal: Briefing beside live map, page navigation and map zoom together
Publisher wind feature content in the pane without a native popup
Existing 2023 road record retains verification-needed status and missing-field qualifications
Release and downstream gauge charts in a single scrolling column
Phone direct link opens map plus briefing; 390x844 and 1280x720 layouts; desktop viewport restored
Fictional alert selection opens evidence; empty-source exercise closes the removed selection
Map tools docked; Escape closes the pane; 3D terrain and briefing coexist
limitations: Map and evidence share available screen space; phones use a smaller map and scrollable evidence.
Actual ArcGIS authorization screens remain controlled by the SDK / identity provider. No authentication behavior changed.
Named-account / partner acceptance and AGOL permissions remain existing prerequisites, not newly certified by UI tests.
